{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A navy blue cotton-poplin button-front shirt, tailored with a slightly relaxed fit and a crisp collar, soft white in hex #FAFAFA.
Slim-fit dark denim trousers in indigo wash, hex #2F4F4F, featuring a straight leg and mid-rise waist.
Minimalist silver pendant necklace on a delicate chain, hex #C0C0C0.
Leather ankle boots in brown, hex #8B4513, with a low block heel for comfort during the long day.

This outfit works because it perfectly balances professionalism with comfort for a standard office day in autumn, adhering to the everyday dress code you requested. The dark denim and cotton shirt provide a neat yet approachable look that fits seamlessly into an office environment without feeling stiff. The earthy tones of the brown boots complement the cool blue of the denim and shirt while keeping the silhouette grounded and practical for cooler weather. By avoiding overly formal fabrics or accessories, this ensemble respects your preference for a natural, unforced style suitable for daily work tasks."}
